Name: Lumisteria Wallpapers - Custom Wall and Floor
Author: Lumisteria
TagLine: Add multiple wallpapers and floors. Some are using vanilla assets, some are entirely custom.
Description:
Note : this mod is using a framework that isn't currently maintained and there's now an option to add wallpapers with CP.
So i suggest you to rather use the version of this mod using this feature, you can find it here :

https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9753

Thanks for liking my mods !

This mod adds multiple new wallpapers. Some are using vanilla assets, some are entirely custom.

All these wallpapers are in addition to the existing ones, they don't replace anything. You need to use [Custom Walls and Floors](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3010)https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3010
**1.1.0**
- Adding 16 new sets of wallpaper (each with 2 variations)
- Adding 40 new floors

In my [Bed Recolor](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/361) mod you can find assorted bedsheets for your house.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Note that there are some issue with the Custom Walls and Floor mod, i can't do anything about them. In some cases, the wallpapers will disappears and you have to put them again.
